summary: Frontend-only regression after 'Route Tower' rename, /pricing route, animated map markers, notification-preview and carrier-analytics additions. All flows verified against public URL. Landing page DOES scroll from hero all the way to the footer (docH=11604, scrolled to y=10524, footer visible). Anchor nav (#journey/#exceptions/#solution) works via lenis and also correctly navigates home from /pricing before scrolling. Demo modal flow submits successfully (POST /api/leads -> 200) and demo-success renders. WorldMap and NotificationPreview render. Pricing page renders all 3 tiers + matrix + CTA, and tier-cta-enterprise opens the demo modal. Dashboard shows 'Route Tower Dashboard · Demo' with carrier-analytics rows 0..5. Shipment /shipment/CT-10188 renders DELAYED status.
